summary.name: Stable Diffusion Online
summary.one_liner: A free online web interface for generating images from text prompts using the Stable Diffusion XL model.
use_cases: Trying Stable Diffusion without local installation
Making images for personal or commercial use
summary.what_it_does: The page presents an online interface where users type a text prompt and click Generate to create images using Stable Diffusion XL. It shows a gallery of example prompts with generated results. The FAQ describes Stable Diffusion as a latent diffusion model that compresses images into latent space and is trained to reverse a noising process, and notes support for inpainting and outpainting. It states that images created through the site are released under CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication. It also mentions a related Prompt Database and that SDXL Turbo generates images in a single step.
notable: Uses Stable Diffusion XL with a larger UNet backbone than earlier versions
Images created on the site are CC0 1.0 public domain
Gallery of example prompts with generated images
Lists GPU requirements for running Stable Diffusion locally (Nvidia or AMD with 8GB+)
caveats: Page does not state whether any paid tier exists; it describes the service as free
The FAQ says copyright of AI-generated images varies by jurisdiction
Training data (LAION 5B subset) had no artist opt-in or opt-out
